build_hourglassnet_backbone: build an HourglassNet backbone with default 2 stacked hourglass modules for human pose estimation
run_hourglassnet_forward: run forward pass on HourglassNet with a 511x511 input tensor to get multi-scale feature outputs
create_hourglassmodule_recursive: create a recursive HourglassModule with configurable depth, stage channels, and stage blocks for feature extraction
init_hourglassnet_weights: initialize HourglassNet weights by resetting all Conv2d layer parameters for training
review_hourglassnet_architecture: review the HourglassNet stacked hourglass architecture with stem, hourglass modules, inters, and output convolutions
